2024 generative AI SaaS survey premium willingness pay commoditized customers

sources_considered.why: Original survey summary reports adoption, willingness to pay and uncertainty about returns during July 2024.
Original research summary concerns a September 2024 survey, although published later.
The reader returned only the title and publication information, without substantive passages.

evidence_items.explanation: The survey summary reports widespread use alongside uneven willingness to pay and uncertainty about returns. It supplies alternative explanations for weak premiums and does not isolate commoditization as their cause.
The September survey describes differing monetization strategies. It does not measure whether competing features caused lower realized premiums or whether their operating costs were excessive.

unresolved_gaps: No retrieved study isolates widespread feature availability as the cause of reduced SaaS AI pricing power in the target period.
No representative provider count or feature-level cost-and-revenue comparison establishes the breadth of the claim.
The source supplies no accounting basis for its cost assertion.
